title: A block on a plate
summary: The smallest useful model: two parts, one placed against the other.

title: Solid shaft in torsion
summary: A solid shaft whose diameter and torque are sliders; the shear stress and twist follow live.

title: Spur gear pair
summary: Two spur gears placed by relation: the wheel meshes with the pinion and turns at the ratio of their teeth. Both shafts stand in a base plate.

title: Simply supported beam: point load and UDL
summary: A 6 m simply supported beam with a 20 kN point load at 2 m from A and 5 kN/m over its whole span.

title: Helical Gear Pair on Parallel Shafts
summary: Single-stage parallel-shaft helical gear pair with 25-tooth pinion and 50-tooth gear showing pitch geometry, center distance, and axial thrust generation.

title: Worm & Worm Wheel Reducer (30:1)
summary: A high-ratio, right-angle speed reducer featuring a single-start steel worm driving a 30-tooth bronze worm gear with self-locking capability.

title: Open Differential Mechanism
summary: An open differential gear train that splits input torque equally between two drive axles while allowing them to rotate at different speeds during cornering.

title: Scotch Yoke Mechanism
summary: A Scotch yoke converting rotary motion into exact simple harmonic reciprocating linear motion via a slotted crosshead.

title: Crank & Slotted-Lever Quick-Return Mechanism
summary: Whitworth crank and slotted-lever drive for a metal shaper. Constant-speed rotation of the bull gear drives a sliding block within the slotted rocker, producing a slow forward cutting stroke and a rapid return stroke.

title: Rigid Sleeve (Muff) Coupling
summary: A rigid sleeve coupling connecting two collinear 30 mm shafts via a solid cast iron sleeve and a sunk key, featuring torsional shear and crushing stress analyses.
